about: How tools/art/staged/early/campus_for_batch3.json was made, on 11 Oct 2026, by the script make_batch3.py (kept in the session's scratchpad, ring2/). It is campus_for_batch2_third.json with the second ring fixed from the owner's chosen pictures (O36): for each place its exits were read off the chosen picture by eye, as points in the 1920x1080 frame, and check_campus.fix_from_layout was called with them (rev 2, the date the owner chose, the chosen render's name, kind composed, batch 2). The points are kept as `first_guess` in the record's `pictures`, as the first ring's are.
THE COPY IS NOT THE RECORD. tools/bgs/campus.json is untouched; the real rows are written at each place's layout sitting.
No prompt was written to a file, no workflow was written and nothing was copied to ComfyUI: the table below was built in memory.

rows_changed_note: Every row listed was a proposal and is now fixed by its place's picture at rev 2. No fixed fact of the first ring or of any earlier picture changed (the script stops if one does), and nothing changed in sheet, rules, areas, campus_map, waived or waits, nor in the picture rows already there. `about` gained one line. fix_from_layout numbers a place's exits from left to right among the exits it was given points for, so the gate's one exit (the Courtyard, ahead) went from order 2 to order 1; the gate's two `seen` rows (the schoolhouse on the left, order 1; the training hall on the right, order 3) are not exits, were given no point and stay proposals. Order is only compared within one side when a prompt is built, so the prompt does not change; the function does not count this as a rewrite.

table_note: Every place of the record whose `after` names staff_yard, gate or trailhead and that has no row in `pictures`. No place stands off the Main Gate (its own `after` is the Courtyard), so none is listed for it. k8_before is k8_place on campus_for_batch2_third.json; k8 is on the new copy. In-place rooms were tried the way the recent sittings were written (redo_job with an empty manifest: the input is the picture the game shows today); composed places by scene_job with an empty manifest, which writes no file. A neighbour's chosen picture is found through `source` in the record's `pictures`, which names the file under ~/Desktop/JJK Game images/ui2/early/chosen/; no scratch root was needed and none was touched. `with_the_named_addition` is the same route with add=True, for a place whose row carries a note about a named addition.
